description: <p>Polls opened on the US east coast on Tuesday in midterm elections that could upend Donald Trump’s presidency, with Democrats looking to seize control of Congress and significantly curb his executive powers.</p> <p>Multiple polls predict Democrats will take control of the House of Representatives and have a shot at seizing the Senate on the back of voter resentment at a deeply unpopular president, soaring energy costs and the dragging conflict with Iran.</p> <figure class='media w-1/2 media--right media--embed media--uneven' data-original-src='https://www.dawn.com/

description: <p>ISLAMABAD: The Islamabad High Court (IHC) on Tuesday granted protective bail to TikToker Muhammad Ansar Jatt, alias “Mr Pattlo”, after a stampede at his <em>mehndi</em> (henna) event in Sialkot claimed two lives.</p> <p>Jatt had announced holding a <em>mehndi</em> event and prize-distribution ceremony at Faraz Cricket Ground on Daska Road on Friday night; however, with hundreds gathered at the site, a <a href="https://www.dawn.com/news/2041211">stampede</a> occurred when the stadium gates opened, killing two and injuring 18 people.</p
